name: Sichuan Xinjinlu Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Xinjinlu Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells green chlor-alkali chemicals in China and internationally. It offers polyvinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, industrial synthetic hydrochloric acid, industrial liquid chlorine, potassium hydroxide, sangra, specialty polyvinyl chloride resin, blending with polyvinyl chloride resin, sodium hypochlorite, sodium hydroxide, calcium carbide, and automotive interior leather/film.
